messages:
alex: handing off now — I'm primary until 23:00 UTC. Ongoing: INC-9876 (embeddings queue p99 spike). Customer impact: elevated latency for embeddings; a small % of requests delayed >5s, no 5xx errors reported so far. Current mitigations in flight are listed below.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-9876 triggered at 2026-03-14T22:08:12Z — metric embeddings-queue.p99 = 9.2s (threshold 5s). Pager sent to #eng-oncall. Alerts -> https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/INC-9876

maria: I just checked eu-west-1 pool — seeing repeated OOM-kills on embedding-worker pods, node pressure on GPU nodes. Logs show KV cache misses spiking.

alex: thanks. I scaled embedding-worker deployment in eu-west-1 from 4 -> 6 replicas to absorb backlog. Command used: ```kubectl scale deploy/embedding-worker -n prod --replicas=6```

sandeep: good. I'm toggling routing fallback to emb-lite for non-critical requests in eu-west to reduce GPU pressure. Patch applied via config: ```routing.policy.region.eu-west.fallback = "emb-lite-v1"``` — will watch for any increased model error rate.

maria: started cache warmer job to pre-warm KV for common prefixes (jobs/warm-kv-eu-west). That should cut cold-start token costs and reduce backend calls.

alex: mitigation summary (in progress): 1) scale workers -> done, 2) enable emb-lite fallback -> done, 3) cache warmer job -> started, 4) temporary prefetch TTL increase from 30s -> 2m to avoid churn.

jen: quick question — any customer-facing outages? Should we open a status page incident?

alex: no hard outages. Some customers (internal alpha customers and a few enterprise eval clusters) reported intermittent slowdown. I recommend NOT opening a public status yet; treat as P3->P2 if any 5xx or >10% error.

ops-bot: ALERT UPDATE: embeddings-queue.p99 dropped to 3.1s at 22:22:05Z after scaling & fallback. Continued monitoring required.

sandeep: adding a throttling policy for large batch jobs temporarily: ```rate_limit.batch_tokens_per_minute = 50000``` — this should protect interactive traffic. Applied on routing service.

maria: note: one eu-west node still shows disk pressure from model cache growth. I'm evicting stale caches on node gpu-22: ```ssh root@gpu-22; systemctl restart model-cache```. Will monitor pod restarts.

alex: coverage notes: primary = alex (until 23:00 UTC), secondary = sandeep (on-call backup until 02:30 UTC). jen will take over as primary at 23:00 UTC. There's a known coverage gap between 02:30-04:00 UTC tomorrow if no one signs up — please flag if you can cover.

jen: I can take 23:00-02:00 UTC primary and then hand to oncall-rotation if needed. I can't cover past 02:00.

sandeep: I can extend to 02:30 as noted. If this looks like it needs long remediation, escalate to platform-eng pager and schedule a quick postmortem.

alex: runbook pointers for next shift (copy these into your notes): Runbook -> https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue.md. Quick checks: 
- dashboard: Monitoring > Embeddings > EU-West p50/p95/p99
- prefix: check KV cache hit rate (metric: kvcache.hit_ratio).
- throttles: routing service throttles table (route /admin/throttles).
- recall trace: use trace id from example problematic request: trace-0abc123 (link: https://tracing.redwood.internal/trace/trace-0abc123)

maria: add to notes — if OOMs persist after scaling, consider shifting some customers to dedicated capacity or reducing model context length to reduce memory. Also file an infra ticket for node disk growth root cause.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-9876 status: mitigations applied, p99 reduced to 1.9s at 22:33:44Z. Recommendation: keep open and monitor for 30m of stability before auto-close.

alex: handing off to jen now — I'm marking this as 'watching' but stepping out. Key things for you: watch p99, KV hit ratio, and any 5xx spikes. If p99 > 5s again or errors >1%, escalate per runbook.

jen: taking handoff — thanks @alex. I'll monitor dashboards and keep this thread updated. I'll escalate to SRE pager if we see >10% queue growth sustained for 5m.

sandeep: leaving as secondary standby. My contact: sandeep (mobile on profile).

alex: final note: post-handoff action items (for follow-up): 1) infra ticket for node disk pressure (maria), 2) evaluate emb-lite quality drift vs baseline (research), 3) consider autoscaler tuning to avoid future warmup spikes.

jen: ack. I'll post a brief after 30m if stable and mark the incident resolved or hand back to rotation. :thumbsup:
